claims.text: The platinum unlocks once the other 54 trophies are earned — nothing else is required.
It is single-player only: the list holds no online trophy and needs no DLC trophy.
PlayStation shows only this description for it: Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.
Most guides put the whole road to platinum at about 200 hours; Push Square estimates 300 hours or more.

claims.text: Attain 100% completion — the checklist is the requirement, not the story alone.
The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the story, but progress made during the story already counts.
The story alone is worth 50% of the checklist; tasks are 27%, exploration 20% and discovery 3%.
Nothing on the 100% checklist is missable — every item can be finished in free-roam after the story.
The checklist asks for roughly 60% true completion: most categories only need part of their total.
Only five groups need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Every source calls this the hardest trophy in the game.
Most guides put the whole platinum at about 200 hours; Push Square says 300 hours or more.

claims.text: Complete 250 stunts; 397 exist in the game in total.
The 397 break down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Any mix of categories counts — there is no per-category minimum.
Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest way to rack up the count.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
100% completion needs 300 stunts, so this trophy unlocks on the way there.

claims.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race, and performing a stunt.

Find activities on the map with the Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon), and track them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
It comes naturally while working on the other trophies — no separate grind is needed.

claims.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.

There are 2 physical ranges holding 12 challenges: Griffin Shooting Range in north-west Vice City (6 challenges, 3 tiers, 18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch, north-east of Port Gellhorn (6 challenges, 4 tiers, 24 golds).
Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk at each range first; rented weapons cost $10 and are good enough for gold.
Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until other conditions are met.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
Range medals also unlock ammo cheats: Max Ammo at 25 bronze medals or more, Infinite Ammo at 25 silver or more, No Reload at 25 golds.
100% completion needs all 42 golds too, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.

claims.text: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditations at 10 spots.
The maths is 1 + 16 + 1: the Chapter 1 house spot counts once, the 8 middle spots count twice (once per character), and the Ascent counts once — 18 in total, not 20.
Spot 1 is the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — the only possibly missable meditation in the game (see the Missables tab).
Whether the Chapter 1 spot is actually required is UNCONFIRMED: it raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest — do it in Chapter 1 anyway.
A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played.
The last spot, the Ascent at the Mount Kalaga summit, only appears on the map after the other spots are done, and needs both characters — possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

The other spots: Smooth Sand (sandbar off west Capri), Swamp (Buckskin Swamp), Camp Moonflower (Emerald River), Red Rocks (Manifest Canyon), Water Wheel (Lummox County), Jutting Cliff (Mount Kalaga National Park), Waterfall (north-west Tallaloko) and Seaside (Waning Sands).
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find spots on the map under Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.
100% completion needs only 15 of 18, so the Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road.
This is the only trophy in the game any source calls possibly missable.

claims.text: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
It needs both characters together, so the earliest chance is after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Call your partner with hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters — the easiest escape.
It also unlocks on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always bring 4 stars.

If it does not pop after three, GTABase reports robbing a fourth shop works — a single-source tip, not confirmed elsewhere.

The jet must be docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not count.
Gates E3 and E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get straight into the plane.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off and get about 1 km from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.
This method is GTABase-reported only — other sources give the description and no method.

claims.text: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat.

Drive through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
This method is GTABase-reported only — other sources give the description and no method.

claims.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — it gives you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry store robberies.
Use the Snap Gun on the store's locked back door; kicking it in sets off the alarm.
Find the note with the safe code in the back room, empty the safe unseen, and leave.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well for it.

claims.text: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape; 8 vaults exist, and 100% completion needs all 8.
Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open.
The haul is too heavy for one character — hand a bag to your partner (hold Right).
Robbing a vault always gives 4 stars, so escape on a fast bike and then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.
Each vault pays up to $205,000 — the best endgame money in the game.
Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000, but only after his earlier quests (including 2 Payday Loan robberies).
Track vaults by scrolling over their icons on the map.

claims.text: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
Armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks: block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
The trophy pops only after you escape the red heat radius — or use a Pay 'n' Spray.
GTABase reports a bank-vault robbery also counts, as long as you escape afterwards; other sources say armored truck only.
Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

Flying a plane over the dark patches is the fastest way to unfog the map.

Exploration counts toward the 100% checklist too, so it finishes while you work on everything else.

claims.text: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, 9 gangs.
Gang operations show as yellow map icons when you are nearby.
Track the count per gang under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang and the bottom-right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
100% completion needs all 39 gang operations.

PowerPyx reports the method as stealing the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and driving it through the showroom window.
You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — and only this blue Banshee works.
KeenGamer still lists the exact method as unconfirmed — treat the Banshee method as reported, not settled.

claims.text: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — a gang operation in Port Gellhorn.

Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe loot in the north-east hallway (blow the safe with sticky bombs).
Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which auto-marks the operation.
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on pickup — and killing enemies is not required.
It is NOT missable: if you miss items, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and grab the rest later (it takes a long time to come back).
Push Square describes it differently — steal the three key valuables at the bowling alley and escape — so the two tellings are shown side by side in the disputes.

claims.text: Max out the Strength stat for BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time.
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
Raise it by working out — buy a gym or fitness-club membership and always go together with both characters, since training one trains the other too.
Filter gyms on the map under Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City.
This method is GTABase-reported only — other sources give the description and no method.

claims.text: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications, and a demon face appears on the right when an action counts.
Profiles run from Professional (stealth objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho — and Irredeemable, which is permanent.
Do NOT push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, and cops shoot on sight more.
The 500-action figure is GTABase-reported only (also via xarmo from GamesRadar+); PowerPyx and EGamers mark this trophy unconfirmed.

claims.text: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on a second attempt.
PowerPyx reports the method: during the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store; return later and rob the SAME store again as Lucia, alone, and escape ON FOOT, not in a vehicle.
The store is the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, and the earliest chance is after Chapter 3's Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loan robberies.
Aim at the teller as in the prologue, steal the money, and run far enough away — the pop is delayed.
KeenGamer still lists this trophy's method as unconfirmed — treat the PowerPyx method as reported, not settled.

Follow the path into the woods to the UFO's bright blue light; approach it, it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer help, then go back to her car at the roadside.
KeenGamer still lists this trophy's method as unconfirmed — treat the UFO method as reported, not settled.

claims.text: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages.
The 4 garages the story gives you do NOT count toward this trophy.
The total cost is about $160,000.

Prices: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800.
Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, installed after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses).
Garages also give you the parking space that On the Spot needs — buy garages first, then register vehicles.

claims.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Moses' Chapter 2 mission installs the Scooter Bros app; take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them.
At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked cars too.
You need free garage space first — each garage adds parking spots — so buy garages (Little Boxes) before grinding this.
Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
